capabilities.name: Control mode
capabilities.summary: Attach a library-managed control client and stream events.

capabilities.name: Named buffer deletion
capabilities.summary: Delete one paste buffer by name without risking another buffer.

capabilities.name: Named buffer rename
capabilities.summary: Rename one paste buffer by name without risking another buffer.

capabilities.name: Layout errors without a checksum
capabilities.summary: select-layout reports a layout string that lacks the leading checksum instead of ending the server.

capabilities.name: Mirrored main layouts
capabilities.summary: Apply main-horizontal-mirrored and main-vertical-mirrored with select-layout.

capabilities.name: JSON layouts
capabilities.summary: Apply a layout in the JSON form that tmux reports.

capabilities.name: Trim blank cells from a capture
capabilities.summary: Stop a capture at the last used cell with capture-pane -T.

capabilities.name: Capture the mode screen
capabilities.summary: Capture what a pane's mode, such as copy mode, is showing with capture-pane -M.

capabilities.name: Capture hyperlinks and line numbers
capabilities.summary: Capture hyperlinks and line numbers with capture-pane -H and -L.

capabilities.name: Clipboard query
capabilities.summary: Ask a client's terminal for its clipboard with refresh-client -l. On 3.3a the server exits when a client attached from xterm or tmux-256color receives it, and on 3.4 to 3.6 it exits when the client leaves before its terminal answers.

workarounds.name: run-shell output goes to the pane
workarounds.summary: With no target pane, run-shell sends job output to a pane's view mode instead of the command's own output, so Shell.capturing refuses.

workarounds.name: break-pane misnames the window
workarounds.summary: On 3.7, break-pane gives the new window the default name when -n is given, and a break with no name can end the server, so Pane.breakOut names the window afterwards and a literal or unnamed break is refused.

workarounds.name: split-window -p reads -l
workarounds.summary: On 3.4, split-window -p reads its value from -l, so a literal -p is refused and the typed split sends the percentage with -l.

workarounds.name: Names with a colon or a period
workarounds.summary: On 3.7, new-session, new-window, rename-session and rename-window reject a name that contains a colon or a period, so the library refuses it first.
